The handler separately rejects inactive memos and SPACE-audience memos before creating the share.

The handler obtains the current user and rejects only a nil user at entry; it resolves the memo from the request parent, rejects a missing or inactive memo, and then applies CanManageMemo. That helper requires a non-nil memo and delegates to ownsOrAdministers, which requires an active user and accepts either creator identity or the administrator role. Thus an authenticated active instance administrator who is not the memo creator passes the strongest visible authorization control. The handler then rejects SPACE-audience memos, while the supplied premise states that the memo is active and non-SPACE. The protected effect is the CreateMemoShare store call, which is reached after these checks and receives the selected memo ID and caller ID. External store failure and later concurrent state changes are outside this authorization conclusion. No decisive source-external fact is required for this declared-entry assessment; source discovery remains not-tested and no repository-wide completeness claim is made.

facts.statement: The CreateMemoShare handler obtains the current user, rejects an unauthenticated nil user, resolves the requested memo, and proceeds through authorization checks before the share-creation call.
The authorization helper treats a user as eligible only when active and allows either matching creator identity or the administrator role.
The handler extracts the memo identifier from the request and obtains the selected memo through the store lookup, treating an empty result as not found.

The handler invokes CanManageMemo and denies the operation when that author-or-administrator control is false; CanManageMemo requires a memo and delegates to the active-user author-or-administrator test.
After authorization and audience checks, the handler constructs a share policy and invokes the protected share-creation store operation using the memo and caller identifiers.
The handler separately rejects inactive memos and SPACE-audience memos before creating the share.
